To enhance the library's service quality, I'd like to point out some current problems and propose possible solutions.

To begin with, the opening hours are rather limited. Many students have classes during the day and can only visit the library in the evening, yet it closes early. For example, it shuts at 9 p.m., which is too early for those who need to study late. A possible solution is to extend the closing time to 11 p.m.

In addition, the book-borrowing system is inconvenient. It often takes a long time to search for books on the computer, and sometimes the information is inaccurate. To solve this, the library could upgrade its software and train staff to maintain the system regularly.

Furthermore, the study environment needs improvement. There are often noisy students in the reading area, disturbing others. The library should set up stricter rules and assign staff to patrol and remind students to keep quiet.

In conclusion, by addressing these issues, the library can provide a better service for students, which will surely be welcomed by the whole school.
